items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the tangent space of a nodal curve with the node-fixed derivations of its normalization (statement lines 6916-6925). The proof (lines 6927-6952) is complete: the split-node setup, the exact sequence from the multicross lemma, the Leibniz-rule annihilator computation forcing D(u) in (u), the extension over k + (u) fixing the branch points, and the converse preservation argument. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: one local algebra computation with a short converse.
